items.title: The Art (and Joy) of Being Prepared
items.summary: There’s a certain kind of magic in being the woman who always has what she needs exactly when she needs it. It’s not about carrying everything. It’s about knowing where everything is. The real secret of how to stay organized: choosing tools that work as beautifully as they look. At Vera Bradley, we don’t believe in chaos disguised as a carryall—we believe in design that listens to your life. With pockets that actually make sense, compartments that never waste space, and accessories that pull everything together like your favorite playlist on a Monday morning, we design for women who move through life with purpose. So whether you’re figuring out how to organize your purse, how to stay organized as a busy parent, or just how to keep your day from unraveling, consider this your permission to organize with joy and a dash of style, too! The Upright Cosmetic Organizer: Where Beauty Meets Order This chic tall cosmetic bag isn’t just for makeup lovers even though it handles bottles, brushes, and essentials like a pro thanks to interior elastic loops. It stands at attention on a vanity or tucks neatly into your weekender, giving everything a home and keeping the beauty chaos at bay. "It is perfect for my weekend getaways. Holds everything that I need." ~ Teri No more digging. No more spills. Just grab it in a flash and close it all up with a quick zip! 3 Pouch Organizer Set: Your Daily Chaos, Sorted by Size Big meeting? Busy morning? Quick coffee run? These three zip pouches are your trio of calm in the storm. Tuck lip gloss and hair ties in the small one. Slide your passport or receipts in the medium. Let the large one handle snacks, hand sanitizer, or that inevitable stash of your kids’ tiny toys from the bottom of your purse. "Great pouches always useful for tucking away important items that you don't want swimming at the bottom of your purse or tote." ~ Patrice You don’t need to learn how to organize your purse from a famous influencer’s videos. All you need is a pouch for every purpose! Hanging Travel Organizer: Not Just for Travel, FYI Yes, it’s called a travel organizer, but you know how to use it on the daily. Hang it in the bathroom, pop it in your gym locker, or keep it in the car for a just-in-case kit. Two mesh zip pockets, a clear zip section for easy-to-see items, and a sleek fold-and-go profile make this a go-to for organizing everything from toiletries to tiny toys. "I love the colors. It hangs in a hotel bathroom or in a guest bath without taking up room on the sink. It's a perfect gift for my graduating niece who is going away to college." ~ Nancy This hanging organizer will help you keep it all together both literally and figuratively. Cord Organizer: Because Life Has Enough Knots Ever gone fishing in your tote for a charger and come up with a tangled mess of tech? Not anymore. Our zippered cord organizer pouch stores cables, earbuds, chargers, and adapters in tidy little mesh pockets that keep things visible and under control. "This is a product I never knew I needed! I use this for work, and keep my laptop charger, mifi, mifi charger, phone charger, and mouse in here. I used to just throw those items in my bag, but having them in this one bag really helps locate them when I need them!" ~ Jeannette It’s a small piece of sanity with a big job: making sure you’re always powered up and stress-free. Lay Flat Travel Organizer: Built for Flat-Out Genius A multitasker’s dream, this zip-close travel organizer opens flat so you can see it all without rummaging and no fuss. Three mesh slip pockets, two zip compartments, and one more zip pocket give you options for organizing self-care essentials, makeup, meds, and more. Plus, it’s sleek enough to slide into your carry-on. "Love the lay flat organizer. It's more shallow than many cosmetic bags so it fits easily in carryons. Holds all of my hair, skin and makeup items. Very happy." ~ James Prepared? Always. Stylish? Obviously. Hair Accessory Organizer: The End of the Scrunchie Scavenger Hunt With a spot for everything (including a heat-resistant slip pocket for that still-warm curling iron), this folding hair accessory organizer keeps your hair accessories collected and ready to go. Two wipe-clean zip pockets handle clips, elastics, and headbands, while the elegant fold-up design ties it all together. It’s like giving your hair a personal assistant. Packing Cube Set: Organization, Elevated These aren't just any old packing cubes. They’re tiny life coaches in fabric form. With four cubes in different sizes (and two with expandable zippers), you can sort outfits, accessories, and even separate clean from “laundry-in-waiting.” "These are the best thing to organize packing. It is easy and better to keep things together." ~ Sharon Whether you’re off on a weekend trip or organizing a diaper bag, these cubes simplify everything. Because Organized Doesn’t Mean Ordinary If you’ve ever felt overwhelmed by the idea of how to stay organized, here’s your gentle reminder: you don’t need to change your personality. You just need the right system. The right pouches. The right pockets. The right patterns that feel like you. Because you are already prepared. These bags just help prove it. Want to make every day a little smoother, your purse or carry-on a little neater, and your life a lot more joyful? Start with what goes inside the bag. Outfitted with three interior slip pockets for your essentials, plus a front and two side exterior slip pockets that are perfect for your phone, keys, and the lip balm you somehow need immediately post-workout. "Love the size, material. I love everything about this bag. Easy to store when not in use. Love the color. Durable." ~ Pamela Capacity: 58L Dimensions: 22" W x 11.5" H x 11.5" D Why You'll Love It: Its zip closure keeps it all contained. Soft carry straps make it a breeze to lug across a parking lot or up five flights. Plus, it's easy to spot clean with mild detergent. And did we mention the popular solids and prints? One Bag for Business Trips and Barre Class Think of our Large Miramar Weekender as your put-together bestie. It's functional, flexible, and polished, even when you're running late. With a zip laptop compartment and tons of space for your workout gear and after-class outfit, this carryall flexes hard for hybrid days. From airport lounges to locker rooms, it keeps your life zipped and sorted. "Beautiful bag! Love all the pockets! Very well made." ~ Carly Capacity: 51L Dimensions: 19.5" W x 12.5" H x 8.5" D Why You'll Love It: An exterior zip compartment that fits up to a 13" tablet. Adjustable strap for crossbody or shoulder carry, depending on the day (and the outfit). This is a small gym bag for women who want sleek organization in a carry-on-compliant package. "This is such a great bag. Well made and lots of room but the bonus of being light weight!" ~ Candy Capacity: 30L Dimensions: 17.75" W x 11" H x 7" D Why You'll Love It: It still fits your tablet and retains the same high-style attitude of the larger Miramar Weekender. Gym Bag or Boss Bag? Yes. For anyone who's squeezing in a sculpt class between client calls, the Knollton Tote is here to hold your laptop, lunch, gym shoes, and that second pair of earrings you always forget you'll need. It's sleek, structured, and sneaky with its storage. Perfect for the days when you're not sure if you're heading to yoga or happy hour, but you're not ruling either out. "I use this bag for transport of my stuff for the gym and pool. Whether it's my shower [supplies], makeup, towel or swim gear, this bag is stylish, roomy and so lightweight." ~ Carie Capacity: 36L Dimensions: 17" W x 15" H x 6" D (with a top width of 26") Why You'll Love It: Comfortable handles, a zip laptop pocket, and an interior setup that keeps everything in its place while you're out and about.
